facts.fact: The OBS-CC observatory says CEMAC Regulation 01-20 of 3 July 2020 on consumer protection for banking services also applies to payment institutions and provides for complaint services and mediation, and Regulation 04/18 requires a permanent complaints mechanism for payment services.

CMR.note: No complaints body in Cameroon, sanction or enforcement figure is stated; MTN and ANTIC figures are fraud and cybercrime counts, not enforcement of these rules.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC Regulation 04/18 of 21 December 2018 on payment services imposes opposition and blocking means, a permanent complaints mechanism and transaction authenticity solutions, and mobile money falls under it.
MTN Cameroon Mobile Money is operating, with MTN reporting over 4,000 fraud cases and attempts in 2025; Orange Money agents are also mentioned.

CMR.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
